## Summary

Senior engineering lead with 5+ years of experience building and directing engineering teams, defining technical architecture, and establishing engineering culture across fast-moving product organizations. At Dinetap, led a team of 8 engineers across 5+ concurrent product streams, drove a monolith-to-microservices migration that achieved near-100% uptime, reduced AWS infrastructure costs by 49%, and built a payments platform now processing over SGD 13.5M per month. Known for combining hands-on technical depth with a strong focus on team growth, knowledge sharing, and engineering quality.

## Key Achievements

- **49% AWS infrastructure cost reduction** - Designed and owned the full AWS cloud infrastructure from scratch using CDK. Migrated a monolith to ECS Fargate microservices achieving near-100% uptime.
- **SGD 13.5M/month payment volume** - Led a team of 7 engineers to deliver an end-to-end payments platform across Adyen, Stripe, and WooCommerce integrations.
- **100K+ app downloads** - Contributed to XLife, the XL Axiata employee super-app with 100K+ downloads.
- **Engineering Quality Programme** - Eliminated all manual release steps, enabled daily automated deployments with GitHub Actions CI/CD, SonarQube, and AI-assisted code review.

## Notable Projects

1. **AWS Microservices Migration** - Architected full AWS cloud infrastructure from scratch using CDK. Migrated monolith to ECS Fargate microservices, eliminating platform-wide outages. Solo architecture owner. 49% cost reduction, ~100% uptime.

2. **Dinetap Payments** - Led a team of 7 engineers to build end-to-end payment processing across card, digital wallet, and physical terminal surfaces. Integrations: Adyen, Stripe, Airwallex, WooCommerce. Processing SGD 13.5M/month.

3. **Dinetap Consumer App** - Flagship consumer dining app for restaurant discovery, table booking, ordering, and payments with cashback rewards. Led 6 engineers end-to-end. Built on React Native + Expo.

4. **Engineering Quality Programme** - Company-wide CI/CD with GitHub Actions, AI-assisted code review, SonarQube security scanning. Zero manual release steps. Daily deployment cadence.

5. **Dinetap POS** - Offline-first, cloud-synced point-of-sale with multi-device conflict resolution. Led 6 engineers.

6. **BaseNeo ERP Framework** - Built from scratch at EchonLabs, now underpinning 20+ production applications. Designed the architecture and directed the engineering team.

7. **LOLC Customer Portal** - Consumer-facing mobile app with 20K+ downloads. Tech lead for web portal and mobile app.

8. **XLife (XL Axiata)** - Employee super-app for XL Axiata Indonesia. 100K+ downloads. Cross-functional international team.
